# ZoomWorkplace

Zoom offers an easy-to-use, hardware-agnostic, cloud-based UC platform powered by AI.

Scroll to bottom of the hero section

![zoom partner program badge image](https://avispl.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/06/zoom-partner-program-2025-1.png)

### AVI-SPL is a Zoom Up Platinum Reseller

We’re experts in Zoom Phone, Spaces Implementation, and Spaces Sales. Let AVI-SPL’s experienced team help you design and deliver Zoom solutions that create an effective hybrid workplace. When you work with AVI-SPL, we:

- **Deliver value** – improve your team productivity and efficiency and measure the benefits with [actionable data insights](https://avispl.com/symphony/)
- **Enhance user experience** – ensure secure, seamless, and a positive user experience
- **Ease IT operations** – manage the planning, implementation, and support of your Zoom solutions to achieve your goals

[Contact Us](https://avispl.com/zoom/#contact)

![Man in plaid shirt sits at modern office table, engages in a video call on laptop; hands gesturing. Large windows, contemporary decor.](https://avispl.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/02/Hybrid-Workforce_Experiences_mock-31-scaled.jpg)

### Set up Your Teams for Success with Zoom

Zoom Workplace offers solutions for meetings, conference rooms, and collaboration spaces, phone systems, scheduling panels, and digital signage.

- **Meetings:** Zoom meetings deliver HD video and audio collaboration.
- **Chat:** Teams stay connected and streamline their communications.
- **Zoom Phone:** Build an enterprise-level phone system that fully integrates with Zoom.
- **Zoom Rooms:** conference rooms that make it easy to connect with the touch of a button. [Zoom’s Conference Room Connector](https://www.zoom.com/en/products/meeting-rooms/features/room-connector/) allows you to use existing hardware to host meetings in the Zoom cloud.
- **Zoom Video Webinars:** Connect with live audiences of up to 50,000 people. Stream your event on YouTube Live, Facebook Live, and other custom streaming services.

![Bright cartoon of a video call of four people.](https://avispl.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/01/zoom-1.jpg)

### Zoom Services by AVI-SPL

AVI-SPL globally delivers and supports Zoom Workplace solutions to connect on-site and remote workers. Our team includes certified specialists in [design](https://avispl.com/services/design-planning/), integration, regional and global implementations, and [24/7 support](https://avispl.com/services/support-and-maintenance/).

[Contact Us](https://avispl.com/zoom/#contact)

![Laptop and smartphone displaying Zoom interface with video call features, colorful graphics on a light blue background.](https://avispl.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/02/zoom-workvivo-large.png)

### Workvivo by Zoom

Workvivo is an employee experience platform (EXP) that simplifies internal communication and drives engagement. It brings company culture to life digitally, helping everyone feel included, appreciated, and engaged wherever they work. Workvivo helps you:

- Communicate and synchronize your staff, from desk to frontline, using one digital platform.
- Easily share resources like documents and WIKIs.
- Create a stronger connection between your employees, their culture, and values
- Collect employee opinions, feedback, and sentiments using multi-touch approaches that reach and engage people in real time.

##### AI Companion

Transform how you work with an AI-first approach to streamline communications, improve productivity, increase employee engagement, and optimize flexible work.

##### Zoom Contact    Center

Humanize customer experiences with AI. Deliver seamless, highly personalized customer care on one familiar platform with industry-leading cloud contact center software.

##### Zoom    Phone

Zoom Phones seamlessly integrate with Zoom Meetings, making it super easy to switch between calls and video conferences. Plus, they offer reliable call quality and a user-friendly interface.

##### Productivity

Improve productivity with products built for modern work, including whiteboard, clips, surveys, and docs.

##### Spaces

Optimize office experiences and hybrid work collaboration with Rooms, Workspace Reservation, Visitor Management, and Digital Signage.

##### Apps and    Integrations

Surface apps within Zoom or embed Zoom into third-party apps like Microsoft and Google.

## Howcan  wehelp?

Discover how our Zoom experts can transform your hybrid workplace with a single solution. We’ll help you design solutions that enhance productivity and support your employee experience goals.  We offer:

[Contact](https://avispl.com/zoom/#contact)

- ###### Comprehensive collaboration    solutions




Explore how Zoom Workplace helps you create a productive hybrid workplace for your distributed teams. Our certified specialists provide [design](https://avispl.com/services/design-planning/), integration, and regional and global deployments.

- ###### Strategic business and    technology alignment




The team’s subject matter experts can advise and guide you through seeding and proof-of-value programs that align with your business needs. The practice offers strategic roadmap services to establish the link from what’s possible to real business outcomes.

- ###### Tailored adoption and    support services




The first part of your journey is crucial. Let AVI-SPL help you define your business outcomes and plan your implementation, engage your user community, maximize business value, and track success.


### Videos

[![A person in a pink suit descends white stairs, passing the Zoom Workplace logo; sleek setting with blue lighting and a plant.](https://avispl.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/02/Thumbnail-zoom.jpg)](https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/Gp_Q6XrNWSU)

[![Sure, heres a concise illustration description:  In a virtual meeting interface with four colorful quadrants, each features a diverse cartoon persona. The bottom right character has a speech bubble saying, Morning, all!.](https://avispl.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/02/Thumbnail-zoom2.jpg)](https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/c_m9hXU8ylY)
